Severe Weather Warning for Snowy Mountains
warnings.desc: DAMAGING WINDS averaging 80 to 90 km/h remain possible across alpine areas above 1900 metres overnight into Wednesday morning. Winds are forecast to ease below warning thresholds during Wednesday morning. Locations which may be affected include Thredbo Top Station. 84 km/h mean winds were observed at Thredbo Top Station at 4:50am and 10:30am Tuesday.

warnings.title: Severe Weather Warning for North East, West and South Gippsland, East Gippsland
warnings.desc: DAMAGING WIND GUSTS of up to 100 km/h remain possible about the alpine ranges overnight into the early hours. Winds are forecast to ease below warning thresholds before dawn on Wednesday. Locations which may be affected include Falls Creek, Mt Hotham and Mt Buller. 93 km/h wind gust recorded at Mount Buller Airport at 10:06pm Tuesday. 94 km/h wind gust observed at Mount Hotham AWS at 7:03pm Tuesday.
